result_text:
The region manager's overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated the method's comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are still left out.

`RegionManagerService` is the only caller of that method, so the overview picks up the new order without any other change.
